aboutMe.introduction_one: Hey there, I'm Denis. I'm a Fullstack Developer in training with a passion for creating interactive web applications and learning new technologies. I enjoy tackling challenges, finding elegant solutions, and growing with every project I build. For me, coding is a continuous journey of learning and improvement.
aboutMe.introduction_two: Let's collaborate and build something remarkable together!

skills.text: Working with modern frontend technologies has given me a strong foundation in building responsive and user-friendly web applications. I enjoy learning new concepts, improving my problem-solving skills, and continuously growing as a developer. I'm always open to new technologies and currently expanding my expertise into backend development.

projects.introduction: Take a look at the projects I've worked on and the skills I've applied along the way. Each project includes a brief overview, key information, and the opportunity to explore it in more detail.

description.elPolloLoco: A 2D side-scrolling jump-and-run game built with JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas, featuring object-oriented programming, sprite animations, collision detection and an exciting end boss battle.
description.pokemon: An interactive Pokédex application built with JavaScript and the PokéAPI. Browse, search and explore Pokémon with dynamic data fetching and a responsive user interface.

pokemon.description: An interactive Pokédex application built with JavaScript and the PokéAPI. Browse, search and explore Pokémon with dynamic data fetching and a responsive user interface.
pokemon.implementation: During this project, I independently integrated a REST API and developed a responsive user interface. It strengthened my skills in JavaScript, asynchronous data handling, and structured frontend development.

elPolloLoco.description: A 2D side-scrolling jump-and-run game built with JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas, featuring object-oriented programming, sprite animations, collision detection and an exciting end boss battle.
elPolloLoco.implementation: I developed this project independently with a focus on object-oriented programming and interactive game logic. It strengthened my skills in software architecture, animations, and building complex JavaScript applications.
